cause: A malformed request target (GET //a:b) threw inside the request handler outside any try block; nothing caught the rejection, so the process exited and systemd restarted it in a loop
fix: Parse the URL inside the try, answer 400, add a crash guard on each request
regression_test: S1 a malformed request target gets 400 and the server stays up
lesson: Every parse of untrusted input belongs inside the error boundary; test the weirdest request first

cause: decodeURIComponent on a bad cookie value threw URIError (500, and login blocked until the cookie was cleared)
regression_test: S2 an undecodable cookie is ignored: 401 instead of 500, and login still works

found_by: Own audit (round 4) and round-5 testers T3, T5, C1
cause: The public, unauthenticated log endpoints re-verified the whole hash chain on every call, synchronously; the log grew with every reprint, so cost grew all week
fix: Cache the chain check 30 s, return only the last 200 entries, index the log, log only the first fetch per card and the first 3 reprints per seat
regression_test: S3 the full chain is checked at most every 30 s; R5-S1; R5-S2
lesson: Anything an anonymous user can trigger must cost the same however much data exists

found_by: Own audit (round 4, reproduced with a forensic script)
cause: Setting a column to NULL leaves the old bytes in SQLite free pages and the write-ahead log, so deleted question ciphertext and wrapped shares were recoverable; the matching test searched for plaintext that was never stored, so it passed vacuously
fix: secure_delete on, checkpoint after seal and after each verify, test searches for the stored ciphertext bytes
regression_test: S6 after seal and verify, no stored question ciphertext or wrapped share is left anywhere in the data files
lesson: A test must be able to fail: mutate the code and watch it fail

cause: official-setup printed every official passphrase to the operator, so one person could claim all five key cards
fix: Operator-made accounts must set their own passphrase at first login
regression_test: S11 accounts made by the operator must set their own passphrase
lesson: The person who provisions accounts must not keep the ability to use them

cause: Automatic 5-second polling refreshed the idle timer, so the 30-minute idle logout never fired on watched pages
fix: Polling requests carry X-LP-Background and do not refresh the timer
regression_test: S12 background polls do not refresh the idle timer
lesson: Features that keep a session warm silently defeat timeouts

cause: Approvals were stored in the database but the shares only in memory, so after a restart the release read '4 of 3 approved' and could never open
fix: Mark pending releases interrupted at start-up and tell the user to request again
regression_test: S4 a restart marks a release with approvals interrupted
lesson: State split between disk and memory must be reconciled at start-up

class: Denial of service by lockout / veto without credentials
cause: Five wrong two-word attempts closed the whole release request, so a holder could veto without knowing the words, contradicting 'refusing needs the words'
fix: Lock out that holder only, per request; refusal still needs the words
regression_test: R5-S7 five wrong word attempts lock out that holder for that request only
lesson: A lockout counter must be scoped to the attacker, not to the shared resource

cause: The Kelvin sign (U+212A) lower-cases to ASCII k, so the ASCII username pattern accepted it and it aliased another account; zero-width and bidi characters were accepted in names and questions
fix: Validate the ASCII pattern on the raw string before lower-casing; reject control and format characters
lesson: Normalise or validate in the right order: check, then transform

cause: Every extension-less path (/admin, /metrics, /deploy/Caddyfile) returned 200 with the app shell
fix: Only / and real files serve; everything else is 404
regression_test: R5-S11 only / and real files in public/ are served
lesson: Single-page fallbacks make scanners report phantom pages

cause: Opened papers (about 99 KB each) were never evicted from memory; enough hostile exams would exceed the service memory limit and restart everything
fix: Keep at most 200 open papers and lock an idle paper after 6 h
regression_test: R5-S10 at most 200 papers stay in memory
lesson: Every in-memory map needs a bound

cause: /healthz returned a constant, so it stayed green with a read-only disk or a deleted database, and nothing at start-up checked database integrity or the log key
fix: Deep health check (SELECT 1 and a cached quick_check); start-up integrity and chain check, degraded mode answers 503
lesson: A health check that cannot fail does not protect anything

class: Missing security headers on non-app replies
cause: Node's own replies (missing Host, Expect: foo, header timeout) had no security headers, contradicting the claim that every response has them
fix: Route those requests through the normal pipeline and add the headers to raw replies
lesson: Check headers on every status code and every path through the stack, not only the happy path

cause: The guide still had placeholders for the course code and certificate, the Exam cell tab did nothing right after Seal, and the trace claimed to name a seat when several matched
fix: Fixed course code, tab refresh, trace says when several seats match, guide rewritten against the app
regression_test: R5-S8 trace says so when several seats match
lesson: Every sentence of a guide is a testable claim
